title: Transcendence of dendric beta-expansions with pure discrete spectrum
summary: We prove the transcendence of numbers that have $β$-expansions (in algebraic bases $β$) belonging to dendric shifts with pure discrete spectrum, under combinatorial conditions on their directive sequences of substitutions. This includes Arnoux-Rauzy sequences on arbitrary alphabets and Cassaigne-Selmer sequences. The proof uses Rauzy fractals and the subspace theorem.
